name: know-qa-agent
description: v0.1.1 — Point it at any web app and it tests like a skeptical engineer, then reports what broke and why, with the evidence. A deterministic engine tracks the full test matrix so requested coverage can't silently disappear. Accessibility runs in two tiers: baseline checks ride along in every test — keyboard reachability, visible focus, alt text, form labels, obvious contrast problems — and a deeper tier you turn on per test adds the full bundled axe-core ruleset and WCAG AA contrast ratios computed from resolved colors, each finding carrying the success criteria it maps to. Anything the tools cannot resolve is reported as needs-review rather than guessed, and none of it is a conformance evaluation or a substitute for testing by a person. Findings come back triaged, deduplicated, and ready to file, and a team can split the app into owned areas with roll-ups posted to Slack. Standalone.
